themes.title: Right‑Wing Media Critique Surge
themes.blurb: Across the Atlantic, right‑wing outlets and politicians intensify attacks on mainstream media, framing journalists as hostile elites and alleging antitrust violations. In the US, the DOJ probes major TV networks over the suspension of White House pool coverage, while Norwegian FrP leaders denounce sensationalist reporting, and French RN members publicly challenge media accusations, signalling a coordinated narrative of media distrust.

themes.title: Intra‑Party Power Struggles
themes.blurb: Right‑wing parties confront internal disputes over leadership and strategy. In the US, Trump pressures Senate Republicans and fuels GOP factionalism ahead of midterms. Norway’s Progress Party experiences infighting between FrP and Høyre and leadership contests, while France’s RN mounts legal offensives to defend its leader. These parallel battles reveal a transnational pattern of intra‑party tension.
